subject: CHEMISTRY

D3.protected: Learner owns the bridge between separately taught chemical concepts

D4.protected: Learner owns decisive model/strategy/exception/warrant under unfamiliar conditions

common.canonical_truth: Reference the Chemistry concept library; never derive scientific truth from source item labels
common.unit_scope: Class X NSEJS; extension/enrichment explicitly marked
common.representation_binding: Diagrams must bind exact species, state, coefficients, bonds, apparatus and measured quantities to reasoning steps
common.core1a: Teach assumptions/definitions, mechanism, derivation, worked construction, plausible wrong path, repair, independent checks for all mapped demands
common.core1b: Predict; commit; reconstruct; diagnose; repair; boundary with complete closure, preserved attempt and no hint leaking W
common.gap_policy: Builder changes adapter only; missing subject-wide capability yields documented blueprint gap. No silent shared QRT edits.
common.review_status: A draft subject layer does not authorize 14 published tiles or QRT acceptance

D3.1.decisive_act: Reconstruct or select a fact, category, definition, property, unit, or condition.
D3.1.protected_work: Leave the important bridge between ideas, representations, or models to the learner; support may expose the component ideas separately.
D3.1.hint_posture: Orient dependencies and component ideas, but do not make the bridge or ordering decision for the learner.
D3.1.chemistry_warrant: Decide by defining chemical condition, species and phase rather than keywords
D3.1.chemistry_evidence_target: Discriminate similar compounds or states using multiple independent chemical conditions
D3.1.plausible_wrong_route: Keyword recall substitutes for chemical classification
D3.1.representation_job: Comparison table showing discriminating chemical features
D3.1.independent_check: verify against the definition, unit, category boundary, or a counterexample
D3.1.example_kind: Author a grounded multi-step bridge with independently checkable conditions

D3.2.decisive_act: Explain why a relation, mechanism, pattern, or result holds.
D3.2.protected_work: Leave the important bridge between ideas, representations, or models to the learner; support may expose the component ideas separately.
D3.2.hint_posture: Orient dependencies and component ideas, but do not make the bridge or ordering decision for the learner.
D3.2.chemistry_warrant: Build a causal link from structure/particles/electrons/conditions to observation
D3.2.chemistry_evidence_target: Explain how a changed microscopic assumption causes an observed chemical change
D3.2.representation_job: Mechanism stages, particle or bond diagrams linked to each explanatory step
D3.2.independent_check: test the explanation against a changed condition, counterexample, or predicted consequence
D3.2.example_kind: Author a grounded multi-step bridge with independently checkable conditions

D3.3.decisive_act: Execute a known model, algorithm, relation, or procedure under the right conditions.
D3.3.protected_work: Leave the important bridge between ideas, representations, or models to the learner; support may expose the component ideas separately.
D3.3.hint_posture: Orient dependencies and component ideas, but do not make the bridge or ordering decision for the learner.
D3.3.chemistry_warrant: Check reaction balance, units, limiting species, state and applicability before computing
D3.3.chemistry_evidence_target: Quantify a reaction in multi-stage conditions, including a genuine domain check
D3.3.plausible_wrong_route: Runs formula with wrong species, coefficients, or boundary
D3.3.representation_job: Known/unknown reaction ledger and data diagram
D3.3.independent_check: verify by units, substitution-back, a special value, inverse operation, or an alternate computation
D3.3.example_kind: Author a grounded multi-step bridge with independently checkable conditions

D3.4.decisive_act: Choose or formulate the governing model, law, variables, process, or strategy.
D3.4.protected_work: Leave the important bridge between ideas, representations, or models to the learner; support may expose the component ideas separately.
D3.4.hint_posture: Orient dependencies and component ideas, but do not make the bridge or ordering decision for the learner.
D3.4.chemistry_warrant: Select defensible chemistry model from evidence and its assumptions
D3.4.chemistry_evidence_target: Choose between bonding, solution, reaction, gas, mixture or redox models by validation
D3.4.plausible_wrong_route: Uses favorite chemical law without satisfying assumptions
D3.4.representation_job: Candidate model diagrams with assumptions but not preferred answer
D3.4.independent_check: test the chosen model against its assumptions, dimensions, limiting cases, or a plausible alternative model
D3.4.example_kind: Author a grounded multi-step bridge with independently checkable conditions

D3.5.decisive_act: Preserve meaning while translating between representations.
D3.5.protected_work: Leave the important bridge between ideas, representations, or models to the learner; support may expose the component ideas separately.
D3.5.hint_posture: Orient dependencies and component ideas, but do not make the bridge or ordering decision for the learner.
D3.5.chemistry_warrant: Preserve atoms, charge, formula, stoichiometry, phase, graph scale and connectivity when translating
D3.5.chemistry_evidence_target: Translate chemical narrative ⇄ formula/diagram/table/graph with invariant checks
D3.5.plausible_wrong_route: Copies coefficients or bond symbols with changed meaning
D3.5.independent_check: translate back or compare an invariant or value in both representations
D3.5.example_kind: Author a grounded multi-step bridge with independently checkable conditions

D3.6.decisive_act: Coordinate dependent ideas or steps where route selection is part of the difficulty.
D3.6.protected_work: Leave the important bridge between ideas, representations, or models to the learner; support may expose the component ideas separately.
D3.6.hint_posture: Orient dependencies and component ideas, but do not make the bridge or ordering decision for the learner.
D3.6.chemistry_warrant: Coordinate reaction and observation dependencies while maintaining mass/charge/electron invariants
D3.6.chemistry_evidence_target: Connect two to three constraints in correct dependency order; where appropriate model independent measurements
D3.6.plausible_wrong_route: Solves each observation independently or uses inconsistent intermediate quantities
D3.6.representation_job: Experiment/reaction dependency graph with final bridge hidden pre-attempt
D3.6.independent_check: verify through an independent invariant, alternate route, limiting case, or consistency relation
D3.6.example_kind: Author a grounded multi-step bridge with independently checkable conditions

D3.7.decisive_act: Establish a conclusion from explicit warrants or evidence.
D3.7.protected_work: Leave the important bridge between ideas, representations, or models to the learner; support may expose the component ideas separately.
D3.7.hint_posture: Orient dependencies and component ideas, but do not make the bridge or ordering decision for the learner.
D3.7.chemistry_warrant: Defend chemical claim through structure, balanced evidence, appropriate conditions and counterexamples
D3.7.chemistry_evidence_target: Construct valid proof/refutation and identify what measurements cannot decide
D3.7.plausible_wrong_route: Treats a memorized example or a single measurement as universal proof
D3.7.independent_check: challenge the argument with a counterexample, converse, boundary case, independent derivation, or evidence-consistency test
D3.7.example_kind: Author a grounded multi-step bridge with independently checkable conditions
